digest.title: Cerebras earnings call 2026-11-14

architecture_signals.architecture_freetext: Cerebras avoids HBM entirely; uses wafer-scale architecture with disaggregated inference (AMD GPU pre-fill + Cerebras decode) delivering 5x token throughput per megawatt vs monolithic GPU approaches.

key_quotes: fast tokens command a premium, and our cloud customers tell us that fast tokens generate exceptional gross margins
disaggregated inference delivers substantially more high-speed tokens for the same power
we do not use HBM memory. We believe memory shortages and the price increases associated with them will continue through 2028

indicator_deltas.summary: Evidence for efficiency advantage intensified: current call introduces quantified inference speed thresholds (250 tps crossover, 800 tps GPU floor) and contrasts with prior's qualitative '10x advantage' claim. Disaggregated inference now explicitly monetized as 'fast tokens command premium' with mar

indicator_deltas.summary: HBM avoidance narrative sharpened from defensive positioning to offensive competitive moat. Prior referenced HBM constraints as architectural advantage; current extends claim to sustained market constraint ('memory shortages...will continue through 2028') creating captive customer lock-in.

indicator_deltas.current_quote: we do not use HBM memory. We believe memory shortages and the price increases associated with them will continue through 2028
